prediction.predicted_reply: We understand how frustrating it is to break a pen tip. Based on a similar case, support options and replacement tips can vary depending on your specific pen model, and some users were directed to purchase the tip kit. For further assistance with your Surface Pro 3 pen tips, please reach out to Microsoft Support directly so they can review your options.
